notes.title: Upload and Download Custom Spluzzles
notes.content:
Hi pals! Hope you've been enjoying Splotches. We put a lot of love and care into this project over the last couple years. But we're not even done making it awesomerer (apparently)!

We just launched a place where you can upload and download custom Spluzzles made in the game's level editor. We had to host it on our website for technical reasons--we hope you'll understand!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32537166/efdec2e308c57aced4bbed08420aebd203800a08.png[/img]

[url=https://jollycrouton.com/splotches/spluzzles]Go to the Custom Spluzzle Library[/url]

It's brand new, so there may still be the odd hiccup. If you find any (or don't!), we'd love to hear from you on our [url=https://jlly.co/discord]Discord server[/url].

We also want to thank everyone who snagged the game as part of the 2018 Yogscast Jingle Jam. Thanks to you, over $3 million was raised for charity.

Enjoy, and happy new year!
